gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that {@link TemporalAdjusters#lastDayOfMonth()} moves an {@link AccountingDate} to the final day of its accounting month.
ADDED i2: Accounting calendar that ends on the Sunday nearest the end of August and splits the year into thirteen 4-week months, with the leap week in month 13.
ADDED i3: Month 13 of a leap year (2012) runs 35 days because it holds the leap week.
